meta.name: Score and enrich Webflow leads with OpenAI, Apollo, Pipedrive and Gmail

name: Webflow to Pipedrive lead score and enrichment with Apollo

parameters.content:
# Webflow leads → AI scoring → Pipedrive
### How it works
Every form submission is normalized, enriched with Apollo business data, and scored by OpenAI against your studio's ideal customer profile. Each lead becomes a Pipedrive Person plus a Lead in Leads Inbox. A linked note stores the original details, enrichment, AI score, reasons, and next step.

Only a validated score of **exactly 100** sends an email through Gmail. Scores from 0–99 and unscored leads still go to Pipedrive but do not trigger Gmail.

### Setup
1. Edit **Configure inbox and ideal customer**: enter your notification inbox, Pipedrive subdomain, and ideal customer profile.
2. Select an Apollo Header Auth credential, an OpenAI Header Auth credential, your Pipedrive API credential on all three CRM nodes, and Gmail OAuth.
3. Connect Webflow's form-submission webhook to the production URL. Secure the endpoint before activation.
4. Test new leads, 99 vs 100, enrichment misses, and AI failures.

Apollo and OpenAI may incur charges. The template is inactive and contains no credentials. One submission per execution; duplicate delivery can create duplicate CRM records. See the companion setup guide for recovery and security details.

## 1. Receive and normalize
Set your inbox and Pipedrive subdomain here.
Missing contact fields are flagged, not discarded.
Only malformed/non-form payloads stop the run.

## 2. Enrich and score with evidence
Apollo lookup misses/errors continue with form data.
AI failure, refusal, or invalid output becomes UNSCORED.
Five 0–20 criteria; validated total 0–100. No rounding to 100.

## 3. Save every lead to Pipedrive
Person → Lead → detailed qualification note.
No score filter before CRM. No custom fields required.
Write failures stop visibly; do not blindly rerun creates.

## 4. Notify only at 100
True → Gmail to your configured inbox.
False → finish (the lead is already in CRM).
Gmail errors remain visible; no automatic resend.

nodes.name: Receive Webflow lead
nodes.notes: Acknowledges receipt immediately with HTTP 200, not completion. Inspect n8n executions for downstream failures.

nodes.name: Configure inbox and ideal customer
nodes.notes: Edit these values, not the lead form. notification_email is the one internal inbox to receive 100-point leads; it can be SDR, CS, or Sales.

assignments.name: ideal_customer_profile
assignments.value: Webflowforge is a Webflow studio serving businesses that need Webflow website builds, redesigns, migrations, CMS architecture, technical SEO, or ongoing website support. Ideal leads have a concrete relevant project, a real business, access to a decision maker, a stated budget, and an actionable timeline. Do not assume a minimum budget or company size that is not configured here.

nodes.name: Enrich person and company with Apollo
nodes.notes: Header Auth: x-api-key = your Apollo API key. No personal-email or phone reveal. An unavailable service or unmatched identity never blocks CRM delivery.

nodes.name: Score lead with OpenAI
nodes.notes: Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY. Structured output; store:false. Uses selected business facts and project brief, not unrelated personal attributes.

nodes.name: Validate score and prepare CRM record
Create Pipedrive person
nodes.notes: Select Pipedrive API credential. Uses v2 Persons. A new Person is created per submission; CRM-wide deduplication is not included. No automatic retries on this create operation.

nodes.name: Create Pipedrive lead for every submission
nodes.notes: Creates a Lead in Leads Inbox for every accepted form payload, including 0–99 and UNSCORED. Score appears in the title. No automatic create retry; origin_id is a trace ID, not an idempotency key.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const id = $json.data && $json.data.id; if ($json.success !== true || !Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) throw new Error('Pipedrive did not return a valid Person ID. Check the preceding operation before retrying.'); const lead = $('Validate score and prepare CRM record').first().json; return JSON.stringify({ title: lead.lead_title, person_id: id, origin_id: lead.origin_id }); })() }}

nodes.name: Save score and enrichment in Pipedrive
nodes.notes: Stores the detailed score, evidence and enrichment as a pinned Lead note. HTML is escaped before saving. Failures stop here and are visible in Executions.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const id = $json.data && $json.data.id; if ($json.success !== true || typeof id !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id)) throw new Error('Pipedrive did not return a valid Lead ID. Check the preceding operation before retrying.'); return JSON.stringify({ lead_id: id, content: $('Validate score and prepare CRM record').first().json.note_html, pinned_to_lead_flag: 1 }); })() }}

nodes.name: Is the validated AI score exactly 100?
nodes.notes: Strict numeric equality. A score of 99, null, or a failed validation never triggers Gmail. False intentionally has no outgoing connection.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { if ($json.success !== true || !$json.data || !Number.isInteger($json.data.id)) throw new Error('Pipedrive did not confirm that the qualification note was saved. Inspect the note step before retrying.'); const lead = $('Validate score and prepare CRM record').first().json; return lead.score === 100 && lead.score_status === 'scored'; })() }}

nodes.name: Email the 100-point lead
nodes.notes: Select Gmail OAuth. Sends only to the configured internal inbox, never to an address supplied in the Webflow payload or by AI. Failed sends stop visibly; verify Sent mail before retrying.

parameters.sendTo: ={{ (() => { const inbox = $('Validate score and prepare CRM record').first().json.notification_email; if (!inbox) throw new Error('Set a valid notification_email in Configure inbox and ideal customer. This lead is already saved in Pipedrive.'); return inbox; })() }}
parameters.subject: ={{ $('Validate score and prepare CRM record').first().json.email_subject }}
